v2_changes: Native USDC swap-in (0x3600...0000) — was MockUSDC. Real Arc USDC, 6 decimals on ERC20 interface, 18 decimals as native gas.
NAVOracle.maxDeltaBps bound (default 5000 = 50%) — prevents NAV manipulation by compromised operator
Pausable on IndexToken (buy/redeem/withdrawForRebalance) — emergency kill switch
Pausable on RebalanceExecutor (rebalance) — agent halt without blocking redemptions
AllocationDecided(bytes32 cid, uint16 whaleCount, uint64 reportedAt) event — on-chain provenance: every rebalance commits to an off-chain allocation document hash, IPFS-resolvable
rebalance() requires non-zero allocation CID — reverts with MissingAllocationCID otherwise
Deploy.s.sol takes USDC_ADDRESS / TOKEN_MESSENGER / USYC_ADDRESS from env (mock fallback for local/unsupported)
47 forge tests pass (up from 28 in V1)

cctp_contract_caller_gate.issue: Arc testnet's real CCTP V2 TokenMessenger (0x8FE6B999...42DAA) silently rejects contract callers. EOA → depositForBurn works (verified, tx 0x24f2b089...01c2cf95a burned 0.1 USDC to Arbitrum). Contract → depositForBurn with valid balance + allowance reverts with no error data.
cctp_contract_caller_gate.verification: CCTPProbe at 0xe4F6a70ab9eB591d557011c5A71A8bb8E3B913F6 isolated the gate. Contract approve() works; contract depositForBurn() fails.
cctp_contract_caller_gate.current_workaround: Use MockTokenMessengerV2 in the deployment so the rebalance() flow works end-to-end. The on-chain rebalance still emits AllocationDecided + Routed + NAVUpdated; only the real USDC burn is mocked.
v3_unblockers: Open a Circle support ticket to request allowlisting our RebalanceExecutor on Arc CCTP
Or migrate to off-chain orchestration: operator EOA signs depositForBurn directly after the executor pulls USDC into its own balance

usyc_teller_allowlist.issue: Real USYC Teller (0x9fdF14c5...DC105A) requires wallet allowlisting via Circle support before mint/redeem.
usyc_teller_allowlist.current_workaround: MockUSYC at the address below. Park/unpark events emit normally.

paymaster_not_on_arc.issue: Circle Paymaster operates on Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, Unichain. Not Arc.
paymaster_not_on_arc.current_workaround: Not needed. Arc uses USDC as the native gas token directly — Paymaster's 'pay gas in USDC' value prop is built into the chain.
paymaster_not_on_arc.framing: Replace 'Paymaster' in the stack table with 'USDC-as-gas (Arc native)' — stronger story, simpler stack.

canonical_arc_addresses_referenced_but_n._note: Gateway = frontend integration only via @circle-fin/app-kit. USYC + CCTP need allowlists / op-side orchestration.
